text: The repository's hand-lock checks, TestTheRepositorysHandLocksHold and TestTheRepositorysLocksRatifiedByHandHold, still check every tracked lock ratified by hand, and pass, saying so, when the repository holds none (#525). A factory amendment re-ratifies its project on its issue, so #445's amendment of factory/recovery would leave no hand-ratified lock, and both checks failed on that alone. Their own Git fixtures, with locks ratified for their exact proposals, keep the hand-ratification path covered; invalid or unreadable locks still fail, and both still skip outside a Git checkout.
